public_rationale: Microsoft's reported Loughton withdrawal meets a project-level reading of the trigger. It does not establish the predicted consequences. The reports describe power constraints and continued activity elsewhere, while earlier financing strain cannot demonstrate harm caused by this later withdrawal. No retrieved evidence establishes both market and economic damage attributable to the trigger. With no deadline, the forecast remains open. Under a broader sector-exit reading, the antecedent would remain unestablished and the claim would be not adjudicable.
limitations: The condition assessment depends materially on the meaning of pulls out.
Reliable news reporting supplies the trigger because no standalone primary announcement was retrieved.
The available evidence does not identify a causal effect on the wider economy.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: When a hyperscaler pulls out or debt stops flowing, people will realize AI was a sales pitch, not a thriving industry, and markets and the economy will suffer.
conditions: when the first hyperscaler pulls out or the debt stops flowing

statement.excerpt: I’ll give you one answer: everybody will realize that they conflated a great sales pitch with a thriving industry, and both the markets and the economy will suffer as a result.

from_speaker: when the first hyperscaler pulls out
both the markets and the economy will suffer as a result
our_interpretation: Read the preceding questions as alternative triggers: a hyperscaler withdrawal or a cessation of relevant data-center financing.
A withdrawal from a committed AI data-center project qualifies under a project-level reading. The speaker does not explicitly require an industry-wide exit or a demand-related reason.
A narrower reading requiring a hyperscaler's broad retreat from AI remains possible and would change the condition assessment.
Read everybody will realize as a broad loss of market confidence in the AI investment thesis, not a literal claim about every person's beliefs.
The outcome requires adverse effects on both financial markets and real economic activity attributable to the trigger. Temporal coincidence or a single stock decline is insufficient.
Use broad US markets and economic activity as the primary scope, with international spillovers as additional evidence; the geography is an evaluator choice.
criteria.support_condition: After a qualifying trigger, credible evidence establishes broad reassessment of the AI investment thesis and adverse effects on both financial markets and real economic activity attributable to the withdrawal or financing cessation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A completed episode with credible causal evidence establishes that a qualifying trigger did not produce the predicted joint market and economic harm. A short period without harm is insufficient because no response deadline was stated.
